name: Single-turn substantive consultation baseline
purpose: Establish the simplest workflow baseline: ask one substantive qualitative question, receive one independent expert reply, and end the dialogue without a follow-up.

actions.rule: Ask the expert for an independent judgment on a consequential unresolved qualitative decision in the inherited draft, without asking for calculations, parameters, code, or validation results.
End the expert dialogue immediately after the first reply and pass that reply, including any unresolved caveat, to the modeling agent for independent technical interpretation and validation.

stop_condition: Stop immediately after the first successful expert reply; this baseline does not permit clarification, challenge, or follow-up exchanges.
